tools.name: RunAppTests
tools.description: Replay saved app recordings, or explicit reserved suite __platform_smoke__ for page visibility and immediate JavaScript errors only, without workflow coverage. Explicit project required. Poll GetAppTestRun; NO_TESTS and skipped workflows never count as passes. An existing EngineTestConfiguration is applied automatically. A recording requiring a missing or different configuration fails instead of using production. Reports identify databaseMode and effective mappings.

suite.description: Saved recording UUID/name, or __platform_smoke__ for a limited platform-owned page visibility check; omitted only runs saved recordings

repeat.description: Optional 1 to 5. Replays each recording this many times in fresh browsers; it passes only if every replay passes, and differing results are reported FLAKY. Use 3 to verify a newly saved recording.

outputSchema.description: runId, explicit target, status and maxFixAttempts

tools.name: GetAppTestRun
tools.description: Read a caller-owned run. RUNNING, COMPLETED, ERROR or NO_TESTS. Check counts/classifications; action-only recordings are SKIPPED/NO_ASSERTIONS. scope PAGE_VISIBILITY_SMOKE verifies page visibility only and provides no saved workflow coverage; always report this limited scope.

outputSchema.description: Caller-owned report with target, status, summary, tests and optional reason/evidence

tools.name: ListAppTestRecordings
tools.description: List recorded workflows and their checks for an explicit app.

tools.name: SaveAppTestRecording
tools.description: Save a recorded workflow with optional assertions. Do not change tests merely to hide app failures.

recording.description: Version 1 recording with required name, description and steps; optional id and app-relative startPath.

description.description: Explain the workflow and expected outcome this test verifies.

engineTestConfigurationId.description: Configuration UUID required for replay. Set for agent-authored database tests as well as recorded tests; never a session token.

outputSchema.description: Saved id, version, name, description, startPath, steps, updatedAt

tools.name: DeleteAppTestRecording
tools.description: Delete a recording only when explicitly requested; never remove tests to make a run pass.

tools.name: GetEngineTestConfiguration
tools.description: Read the app-owned optional EngineTestConfiguration. Null means no configured database substitution.

tools.name: SaveEngineTestConfiguration
tools.description: Save real-to-test database mappings without changing app code. Test targets must be dedicated local file-backed H2/SQLite engines. Requires real database view and test database edit access. SEMOSS database calls, including Python callbacks, are routed during recording/replay; direct JDBC/DB-API connections are outside routing. Unmapped app databases fail closed.

id.description: Preserve the existing configuration UUID when updating.

tools.name: CreateAppTestDatabase
tools.description: Create a private empty local test database through normal provisioning permissions. Does not clone production connections, copy data or create app tables. Seed the schema and fixture data before using it.

tools.name: DeleteEngineTestConfiguration
tools.description: Remove the app test profile only when explicitly requested. Leaves test databases intact. Recordings requiring the removed profile stop rather than use production.

tools.name: BeginAppTestSession
tools.description: Begin a caller/session/app-bound 30-minute routing context. Used by the platform recording bridge before reloading the iframe. Does not redirect an already loaded app. Never save its token in recordings.

tools.name: EndAppTestSession
tools.description: Revoke a recording context; late test requests fail closed. The platform Exit test database mode action also restores normal preview browsing.
